title: Victory Lane Indoor Karting
specs: Fastest indoor karting track in the Carolinas
Sodi karts with Honda engines, adult karts up to 35-40 mph, youth karts up to 20-25 mph
Multiple tracks including Super Track with over 20 turns
Drivers 18+ must bring valid government issued ID; driver's license not required
Youth kart drivers max weight 200 lbs; adult kart max weight 350 lbs
Minimum height 58 inches to drive adult kart; under 16 must race youth kart first
Drivers must be capable of safely handling the kart and pass staff evaluation if under 16
All drivers must sign a waiver; minors require parental consent form
Helmet required; full-face DOT/Snell rated helmet required if bringing own
Minimum 8 people weekdays, 10 people weekends for private events

blurb: Victory Lane Indoor Karting offers competitive indoor kart racing with adult and youth karts designed for speed and safety. The facility includes multiple tracks, arcade games, axe throwing, virtual reality, and escape rooms. They also host private events, corporate team building, and youth racing leagues.
extraNote: All racing packages sold per person and non-transferable · No admission fee; activities sold separately · Minimum group size 8 weekdays, 10 weekends for event bookings; 7 days notice required · All transactions must be done in person; no online payment · Safety rules must be accepted and followed · Facility open year-round with no rain-outs due to indoor setting · 2330 Tipton Drive, Suite 100, Charlotte, NC 28206
